invariant_evidence.name: Read-only population availability cannot directly create labour; education and migration are the only implemented skill-entry paths
Private and public occupations consume one unemployed pool and reconcile exactly to aggregate employed
Skill/owner mismatch, vacancy overfill, separation underflow and same-boundary chaining reject before a result
Wages require an existing position, canonical non-negative amount and explicit version; no wage calculation occurs
Canonical ordering, exact retry and fact-payload conflict handling are deterministic
Restored binding identity, aggregate/position reconciliation and population upper-bound violations fail closed

negative_cases: Population availability alone cannot create a labour status.
Education transition without an existing student source rejects.
Job/public occupation with wrong skill or owner, vacancy overfill and separation underflow reject.
A match cannot chain from a position demand in the same fact set.
Negative or non-canonical wage assertion and duplicate position/version assertion reject.
Same fact identity with changed canonical payload rejects.
Restored outer factId alias and aggregate/position mismatch reject.
Labour stock above the read-only population availability rejects.

database_rls_evidence.reason: No database, API, worker, RLS, schema or migration surface is in V11.2 scope.
